    AI Overview
    Cameron and Cayden Boozer are highly-touted freshman twins playing for the Duke Blue Devils in the 2025-26 season. As sons of former Duke champion Carlos Boozer, they are 5-star recruits who committed to Duke in 2024, aiming for a national title. As of March 2026, both are contributing significantly to Duke's success, with Cameron starring as a forward and Cayden as a point guard. 
    Key Details About the Boozer Brothers at Duke: 
    • Cameron Boozer (Forward): A standout rookie for the 2025-26 season, Cameron has been a high-impact scorer and rebounder for the Blue Devils, often mentioned as a top prospect for the 2026 NBA Draft.
    • Cayden Boozer (Guard): A skilled playmaker and point guard recognized for his elite passing and ball security.
    • Impact on Duke: In March 2026, the twins helped lead Duke to an ACC Tournament title and a strong position in the NCAA tournament, frequently leading the team in scoring.
    • Background: The twins attended Christopher Columbus High School in Miami before joining Duke.
    • Legacy: They are following in the footsteps of their father, Carlos Boozer, who was a standout for Duke under coach Mike Krzyzewski. 
    They are considered central to the new era of Duke basketball under head coach Jon Scheyer.
